beats.evidence: The easternmost point of the US by longitude is Pochnoi Point on Semisopochnoi Island, Alaska.
Framing, opinion, instruction or story; no factual claim.
The Aleutian Islands cross the 180th meridian, which separates the eastern and western hemispheres.
Semisopochnoi Island (51°57′42″N 179°46′23″E) is the easternmost point in all US territory by longitude.
Amatignak Island (51°16′7″N 179°8′55″W) is the westernmost point in the US by longitude.
The distance between the easternmost and westernmost US points is about 71 miles.
Alaska is simultaneously the northernmost, westernmost and easternmost state; the southernmost title belongs to Hawaii.
